t_power.instructions: For Power (t_power), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. Main appliance power only; not the switch for an individual feature. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.omit: The user requests no change to the air conditioner's main power.
criteria.0: The user requests switching the air conditioner's main power off.
criteria.1: The user requests switching the air conditioner's main power on.

t_work_mode.instructions: For Mode (t_work_mode), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. Main operating mode. Auto mode is different from Comfort Auto. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.omit: The user does not request a change to the main operating mode.
criteria.0: The user requests Fan or fan-only as the main operating mode.
criteria.1: The user requests Heat or heating as the main operating mode.
criteria.2: The user requests Cool or cooling as the main operating mode.
criteria.3: The user requests Dry or dehumidification as the main operating mode.
criteria.4: The user requests Auto as the main operating mode, rather than the separate Comfort Auto feature.
